seoTitle: Grounded, honest, primary-source. That is the whole method.
editorialIntro: Aloha AI University exists because AI adoption stalls on trust, not on tools. We teach the mechanics so your confidence is earned, not borrowed.

blocks.text: Most AI training sells a feeling and skips the mechanics. We do the opposite. We teach how the models work, where they break, and how to verify what they produce, drawn from primary sources rather than secondhand hype. When you understand why a tool behaves the way it does, you stop fearing it and you stop over-trusting it. You use it well.

Teams do not adopt tools they do not trust, and trust is not a slogan. It is what your brain does when a new tool proves reliable, repeatedly, in ways you can check. So this program is built around verification and honest limits. Every claim you can test, we show you how to test. Every place the tool fails, we name it. That is how adoption actually sticks: by making reliability visible.
Aloha AI is the consulting practice of RN Collins. The work sits at the intersection of AI capability and the trust, governance, and disclosure needs of regulated and reputation-sensitive businesses.
